executive_summary: Grants for SME-led feasibility studies enabling a foreign customer to decide whether to invest in mature Dutch technology. The study covers technical or commercial feasibility and produces a business or project plan; a necessary small test may be included. Funding is up to 50% of eligible costs, or 70% for qualifying green projects, capped at EUR 100,000; eligible project costs must total at least EUR 50,000. Applications run from 2 March to 31 December 2026, after a mandatory RVO quick scan, and studies last at most two years.
status_rationale: The RVO Haalbaarheidsstudies page (Wat is een haalbaarheidsstudie?) and Staatscourant 2026-7891 sections 4.4(b) and 7(2) fund feasibility and basic design for a foreign customer investing in mature Dutch technology. Grid-equipment studies could benefit the procurement needs of the 2GW Program and share engineering mechanisms with InterOPERA, although the latter is a research collaboration rather than an export study. Sections 3 and 4.2 require a foreign customer and exporting or investing Dutch participants; the large-enterprise exception requires a necessary contribution to an SME, and establishes no suitable domestic-customer route for TenneT Netherlands. Type 3 category C3.2 reflects potential benefits through products supplied by others.
